notes.title: Quality of Life Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1] AHOY SAILORS! [/h1] 
Happy lunar new year! We have been hard at work on [i]The Mutineer[/i] and have released a number of changes to improve the quality of life of the game.
Changes include:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where SteamVR would launch when starting the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Overseer could become locked in place.
[*] Fixed latency issues when pulling the alarm.
[*] Updated Chinese UI
[/list]
In the future we will be taking a closer look at MAC compatibility. As always leave a review and let us know what you think!

Thank you,
     -The NOTH team

notes.title: THE ALERT! UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]HAPPY NEW YEAR SAILORS![/b] [/h1]
A fresh update has been released for [b]The Mutineer![/b] In this update we took a look at player feedback and have added some requested features that will help improve the quality of life for all players!
New visual additions include:
[list]
[*] Added a visual notification for when the Mutineer [u][b]sabotages[/b][/u] an engine.
[*] Added animated notification for when engineers are [u][b]repairing[/b][/u] a sabotaged engine.
[/list]
We hope that these new visual notifications, in addition to the original sound cues, should make The Mutineer a more straightforward, enjoyable experience for you and your friends.

Thank you for all your support in 2020, please let us know what you think!

Happy New Year, The NOTH Team.

tags.feature: Added a visual notification for when the Mutineer sabotages an engine.
Added animated notification for when engineers are repairing a sabotaged engine.

notes.title: Chinese / Spanish Support!
notes.content:
[h1] AHOY SAILORS! [/h1] 
We wanted to take the time to go over some updates that may have gone under your nose, as well as things we are planning! We are pleased to report that we have incorporated Chinese and Spanish localization for [i]The Mutineer![/i] Languages can be changed in the options menu.

In the future we are looking forward to implementing some quality-of-life improvements, as well as MAC compatibility for [i]The Mutineer![/i] Stay tuned in for more updates, and please leave a review if you have been enjoying the game!

Thank you,
     -The NOTH team
